children: Fuel Tech reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $8.7 million, up 16% year over year, and a net loss of $267,000. Gross profit was $3.9 million, with a 45% gross margin, while adjusted EBITDA was a loss of $249,000. The company also outlined plans to pursue growth in its core markets, power infrastructure, water treatment and wastewater treatment, alongside selective acquisitions.
Revenue was $8.676 million, compared with $7.490 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Gross profit was $3.905 million, and gross margin was 45%, compared with $3.661 million and 49% a year earlier.
Operating loss was $523,000, compared with operating income of $4,000 in the prior-year quarter.
Net loss was $267,000, or $0.01 per share, versus net income of $303,000, or $0.01 per share, in the third quarter of 2025.
Adjusted EBITDA was a loss of $249,000, compared with adjusted EBITDA of $228,000 a year earlier.
Air Pollution Control segment revenue increased 38% year over year, reflecting a higher backlog and progress on existing contracts; FUEL CHEM segment revenue rose 3%.

Air Pollution Control backlog stood at $16.6 million at September 30, up from $14.3 million at June 30 and $7.0 million at December 31, 2025. The September figure excluded recently awarded contracts valued at $3.3 million.

CEO Ramesh Nuggihalli said the company plans to deepen its presence in core markets and pursue opportunities tied to power infrastructure supporting data centers and AI, as well as water and wastewater treatment.
The company is pursuing selective acquisitions through a bottom-up strategy focused on strengthening its product portfolio and expanding its channel presence.

title: Fuel Tech Reports Q3 2026 Revenue Growth and $267,000 Net Loss
